name: LeadRocks
title: leadrocks.io
shortDescription: LeadRocks offers a comprehensive B2B contact database and tools for data enrichment and email outreach automation. It's designed for sales teams looking to streamline their lead generation process. Users can directly extract contact information from LinkedIn profiles or bulk upload data for enrichment. This tool is ideal for enhancing existing contact bases and integrating with platforms like Sales Navigator for optimized results.
pros: High data accuracy and legal compliance
Integration with LinkedIn for enhanced lead generation
Offers both individual and bulk data enrichment options
cons: No API for developer integration mentioned
Future features still in planning stages
